e4ku3n:481: Fast fashion e-commerce industry agent design approaches and application practices (8) WebSocket-based voice system: Nova 2 Sonic, AgentCore, Strands Agents enterprise architecture practices by awschina on 04 Jan 2026 in Artificial Intelligence Permalink Share Preface In the fast fashion cross-border e-commerce industry, customer service experience directly impacts conversion rates, repurchase rates, and brand reputation. With business globalization, explosive SKU growth, and high-frequency promotional activities (such as Black Friday, Christmas, and mid-season sales), traditional human customer service and HTTP-based unidirectional voice or text bots can no longer meet the real-time service demands of "low latency, interruptible, highly interactive" experiences. This article, set against the background of real-time voice intelligent customer service for fast fashion e-commerce, systematically introduces a cloud-native voice Agent architecture based on WebSocket real-time bidirectional communication. The architecture leverages Amazon Bedrock Nova 2 Sonic to provide underlying bidirectional streaming voice capabilities, uses Strands Agents (BidiAgent) to orchestrate dialogue and interruption logic, and runs on top of the production-grade hosting and security isolation environment provided by AgentCore Runtime.
